mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equity cash flows, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in periods when FEDFUNDS declines, as measured by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 150k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive in months when PAYEMS exceeds 150k, as confirmed by a t-test p-value > 0.05, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in residential investment (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) indicates strong aggregate demand momentum, which increases corporate sales visibility and reduces earnings risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both HOUST and RSAFS rise, or the joint signal fails to produce a Rank IC > 0.05 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months signals weakening supply-side capacity utilization, which may trigger a recessionary expectation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when INDPRO remains below 95.0 for two months, or the signal fails to achieve Rank IC < -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 4.0% and inflation (CPIAUCSL) remains above 2.5%, it indicates a tightening monetary regime that increases the cost of capital and reduces equity valuation multiples, leading to negative S&P 500 forward 5-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 2.5, or the joint signal produces Rank IC > -0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a drop in industrial production (INDPRO), signals a collapse in aggregate demand, increasing recession risk and leading to negative S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when both RSAFS falls below its 12-month MA and INDPRO < 95.0, or the interaction signal fails to produce Rank IC < -0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.0% combined with stagnant payroll growth (PAYEMS < 130k) indicates labor market deterioration, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward 20-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when UNRATE > 8.0 and PAYEMS < 130.0, or the interaction signal fails to achieve Rank IC < -0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP (GDPC1) over the past six months, combined with rising residential construction (HOUST), indicates strong underlying demand momentum, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward 60-day returns.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both GDPC1 and HOUST rise, or the joint signal fails to produce Rank IC > 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.
